messages.subject: html in renderText?
parts:
Hi There,

Really love this Shiny tool. I'd like to do the following: in server.R, function renderText() will be populated with an array of texts, such as

output$dataFile <- renderText({
outwords <- c("Try1 is here", "Try 2 is here", "Try 3 is here")
paste(outwords, sep="\n")
}) 
But all I got is a single line of the outwords array. I'd like to have it separated, so it will be 3 lines. How may I do that if possible? Thanks in advance.

Best,
Baoqiang

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: html in renderText?
parts: Instead of sep, use collapse. Also make sure to use verbatimTextOutput in the ui instead of textOutput.
